description: This file defines the 'Markup' class in Twig, used for marking content as safe and handling character encoding, string conversion, counting, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Markup
classes.description: Represents content marked as safe in Twig, providing methods for string conversion, counting characters, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of Markup with content and charset.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the content as a string.

methods.name: getCharset
methods.description: Returns the charset of the content.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of characters in the content.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the content for JSON serialization.
